about: Generic preparation checklist for an Australian passport holder travelling overseas, before any one destination is chosen. Per-country steps live in the visa-preparation pattern in data/vetting. Every item here is a baseline carried from Luke's earlier repos: recheck it, then set needs_recheck to false and redate checked. Statuses (not started, ready) belong in private/, never here.
rules: No personal values: passport numbers, bank details, bookings or document contents are never stored.
Destination-specific requirements (apostille, translation, sworn copies) must be confirmed at the destination authority and recorded in that place's visa-preparation record.

items.title: Passport runway
items.detail: Check passport validity, condition and blank-page needs against the destination and every transit point.

items.title: Encrypted document vault
items.detail: Keep secure offline copies of identity pages and essential approvals, with a separate recovery method.

items.title: Entry and transit route
items.detail: Recheck the visa, exemption, transit and arrival-form path against current official sources.

items.title: Arrival forms and evidence
items.detail: Complete time-sensitive entry forms and carry the issued approval, onward travel and accommodation evidence.

items.title: Replacement pathway
items.detail: Know where a lost passport can be replaced and how to reach the nearest Australian mission.

items.title: One-paragraph activity brief
items.detail: Describe the dates, every activity, audience, host, payments, benefits and anything sold locally.

items.title: Host invitation
items.detail: Get the legal host, venue, role, dates, audience and payment arrangement in writing.

items.title: Activity permission
items.detail: Confirm permission to speak, teach, sell, perform or work—not merely permission to enter.

items.title: Permit responsibility
items.detail: Record who lodges work, event, cultural, labour, tax or sponsor paperwork and the lead time.

items.title: Money and merchandise split
items.detail: Separate fees, royalties, expenses, ticket shares, book stock, equipment and local sales.

items.title: Health summary
items.detail: Keep a concise private medical and allergy summary that can travel offline without being published.

items.title: Medication runway
items.detail: Check supply, original packaging, prescription evidence and destination restrictions.

items.title: Vaccination and health entry
items.detail: Check destination, transit and event requirements through current health authorities.

items.title: Insurance fit
items.detail: Check medical, evacuation, activity, equipment and advisory-level exclusions for this exact trip.

items.title: Recovery space
items.detail: Leave room for sleep, illness, decompression and a return-to-base reset between intense legs.

items.title: Payment redundancy
items.detail: Carry two independent payment methods and keep them in separate places.

items.title: Emergency reserve
items.detail: Keep a private reserve for an exit, replacement accommodation, health care or a missed connection.

items.title: Access and fees
items.detail: Check card notices, cash access, exchange costs, payment blocks and local acceptance.

items.title: Proof of funds and payment terms
items.detail: Carry only the evidence the route requires and keep contracts, invoices and expense terms together.

items.title: Phone and connectivity
items.detail: Prepare eSIM or SIM options, roaming, key numbers and a plan for arrival without mobile data.

items.title: Power kit
items.detail: Match plugs, voltage, chargers, power bank rules and the equipment actually travelling.

items.title: Account recovery
items.detail: Keep 2FA recovery methods that still work if the main phone, number or laptop disappears.

items.title: Encrypted backups
items.detail: Back up essential work before departure and copy new material again after each major leg.

items.title: Offline layer
items.detail: Download maps, tickets, approvals, translations, host details and emergency contacts.

items.title: Backup communications
items.detail: Choose a second communications path where remoteness, disaster or network shutdown makes it useful.

items.title: Reversible bookings
items.detail: Prefer changeable transport and accommodation until the entry and activity routes are confirmed.

items.title: Onward and fallback route
items.detail: Know the intended exit plus one realistic alternative if transport, weather or borders change.

items.title: First-night landing
items.detail: Confirm the first sleep, airport or port transfer, check-in window and a late-arrival fallback.

items.title: Live disruption check
items.detail: Review weather, strikes, major events, closures and transport changes without treating them as automatic vetoes.

items.title: Modular go-bag
items.detail: Keep a small reusable kit that can support an unplanned short trip while specialist items remain optional.

items.title: Public biography and portraits
items.detail: Keep a short and long biography, current portraits and contact links ready without private identity documents.

items.title: Talk and workshop menu
items.detail: Maintain adaptable abstracts, audience outcomes, lengths, formats and equipment needs.

items.title: Author pack
items.detail: Prepare book summaries, covers, rights contacts, launch formats and a local-seller option for physical stock.

items.title: Teaching evidence
items.detail: Keep relevant qualifications, experience, sample sessions and host-ready learning outcomes.

items.title: Media and equipment list
items.detail: List every microphone, camera, instrument, computer and sale item crossing the border.

items.title: Contract and cancellation
items.detail: Put scope, fee, expenses, tax, recording, rights, cancellation and permit responsibilities in writing.

items.title: Police and background evidence
items.detail: Check whether the exact route needs a current certificate and how the destination defines validity.

items.title: Qualifications and references
items.detail: Keep certified academic, professional and experience evidence ready for work, teaching or talent routes.

items.title: Notarisation, apostille or authentication
items.detail: Confirm the destination-specific legalisation chain before paying for it.

items.title: Certified translations
items.detail: Translate only the documents and languages required by the actual route, using an accepted translator.

items.title: Founder or investor evidence
items.detail: Keep venture, ownership, funding and source-of-funds material separate from permission to work in the venture.

items.title: Language and etiquette
items.detail: Learn useful phrases, hosting customs, sensitive topics and the local rhythm before arriving.

items.title: Explicit consent
items.detail: Ask before recording, photographing, publishing or reusing another person's story; consent stays revocable.

items.title: Cultural and community authority
items.detail: Do not infer permission to speak for a community, culture or Indigenous group; find the responsible local authority.

items.title: Reciprocal contribution
items.detail: Listen first, ask what is useful, contribute without promising more than the visit can deliver, then reflect.

items.title: Keep the receipts
items.detail: Retain entry evidence, permits, official replies and what the host actually lodged.

items.title: Record the real outcome
items.detail: Note what the border or authority accepted, actual processing time, surprises and the fallback used.

items.title: Update only affected claims
items.detail: Refresh the changed claim IDs and dates without pretending every country or pathway was rechecked.

items.title: Recover and recalibrate
items.detail: Back up material, rest, renew documents and let new invitations reweight the next move.

sections.title: Document checklist for business visa applications

provenance.note: reviewed is the file's last commit date; the items carried no dates of their own.

items.title: Passport Bio Pages (Primary & Concurrent)
items.detail: High-resolution colour scans of all pages. Ensure at least 12 months validity and 4 blank pages.

items.title: Birth Certificate
items.detail: Original, certified copy, and high-resolution scan. May require an Apostille.

items.title: National ID Cards / Driver's Licence
items.detail: High-resolution colour scans of front and back.

items.title: Curriculum Vitae (CV)
items.detail: Updated quarterly. Tailor to highlight business experience and qualifications relevant to the mission.

items.title: Police Clearance Certificates
items.detail: From Australian Federal Police and any country of residence for >12 months in the last 10 years. Renew as required.

items.title: Vaccination Records
items.detail: Including International Certificate of Vaccination for Yellow Fever.

items.title: Passport Photos
items.detail: Multiple sets in various required sizes (e.g., 2x2 inch, 35x45 mm). Digital and physical copies.

items.title: Marriage Certificate
items.detail: If applicable. Original, certified copy, and scan. May require an Apostille.

items.title: Proof of Address
items.detail: Utility bill or bank statement from the last 3 months.

items.title: Bank Statements (Personal)
items.detail: Rolling 12 months of statements, updated monthly. Must show sufficient funds.

items.title: Bank Statements (Business)
items.detail: Rolling 12 months of statements for primary business entities, updated monthly.

items.title: Tax Returns (Personal & Business)
items.detail: Previous 3 financial years. Stamped by an accountant if possible.

items.title: Proof of Property Ownership / Assets
items.detail: Deeds, valuation reports. Can demonstrate ties to home country.

items.title: Letter from Financial Institution
items.detail: Confirming account status, length of relationship, and good standing.

items.title: Proof of Comprehensive Health/Travel Insurance
items.detail: Policy document showing global coverage, including medical evacuation and repatriation, for the entire mission duration.

items.title: Certificate of Incorporation (Mission Entities)
items.detail: For GAJRA Earth, Alpha Infinity Foundation, etc. Certified copies.

items.title: Business Plan Summary
items.detail: 1-page summary of Project Odyssey, outlining goals, activities, and timeline in the destination country.

items.title: Letter of Support (From Own Company)
items.detail: Template letter confirming employment, salary, purpose of travel, and that all expenses will be covered.

items.title: Letter of Invitation (From Host)
items.detail: Template to be customised by hosts in destination countries. Must be on their letterhead and often needs to be certified or notarised locally.

items.title: List of Global Contacts/Partners
items.detail: For reference in applications, showing established business connections.

items.title: Company Profile / Brochure
items.detail: Professional document outlining your business activities.

items.title: Proof of Past Business Dealings
items.detail: Contracts, invoices, or correspondence with companies in the destination country, if applicable.
